text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You did it,

Trainer <username>.

In impressive style, no less.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I know, Meek. It's frustrating... Terribly
so.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But at the same time, your training and
your
trainee's running inspired us,

Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Someday... I'll shine too. Just as bright.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer
<username>...

You're my rival—one I wholeheartedly
respect.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So when I say this, I mean it...
Congratulations!
